prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" attorney, but top-rated personal injury firms in Chicago for car accident claims include Disparti Law Group and Malman Law, both known for multi-million dollar recoveries and extensive local experience. Malman Law +1
Disparti Law Group: Led by Larry Disparti, this firm has over 20 years of experience, has recovered over $2 billion for clients, and handles complex auto, truck, and motorcycle crash claims. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers
Malman Law: With over 30 years in practice, the firm has recovered more than $750 million across 20,000+ lawsuits with a high success rate. Malman Law
Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.: A prominent catastrophic injury and auto accident firm in Cook County with over $3.5 billion in total verdicts and settlements. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.
Briskman Briskman & Greenberg: Serving Chicago since 1987, focusing on auto, truck, and pedestrian collisions on a contingency fee model. Briskman Briskman & Greenberg +1
Contingency Fee: Reputable personal injury lawyers do not charge upfront fees; they only get paid if they win your case.
Free Consultation: Most top firms offer a free initial case evaluation so you can discuss your options without financial risk.
Trial Readiness: Choose an attorney who is fully prepared to take your case to court if the insurance company refuses to offer a fair settlement. Briskman Briskman & Greenberg +3
